They were weak, but would still be revered as Gods in your realm.|audio = GodCubeQuoteBlindFaith.ogg|[[Lord Exo]] in the second cutscene of [[Blind Faith]]}} }} {{ScrollTOC|500px}} ==Description== The '''God Cube''' is the prime object of focus within the Tower Defense Simulator storyline. Back when [[Lord Exo]] still retained his original body, the '''God Cube''' was created to serve as a prison for his spirit. The souls of thousands of powerful beings were sacrificed by [[Two X]] to create the '''God Cube'''. Upon contact with the '''God Cube''', primarily through absorption into the body, living beings will become corrupted by its power. The being's form will mutate, resulting in a change of physical appearance, a prolonged life or functional immortality, and a significant increase in power.Most notably seen with [[The Umbra]] in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. Additionally, the '''God Cube''' can also be used as a power source, being able to power giant mechsMost notably seen with the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] or improve one's ability to cast spellsMost notably seen with [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] in the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. ==Hosts== "Hosts" are beings that have been corrupted by the '''God Cube's''' power. The effects of the '''God Cube''' on life are not uniform, as each host is affected differently. The only distinguishable similarity among hosts is physical empowerment. Currently, only nine hosts are shown within the canon of Tower Defense Simulator. Three more are shown in the [[Null & Void Event]], that being the [[Brute]], [[Grave Digger]] and [[Molten Warlord]], however, they are only listed as people who [[T.D.S. Organization]] recovered a fragment from. Nothing past that, including how they used it is actually elaborated on, and because of this they will simply not be listed due to a lack of information. {{Clear}} ===Patient Zero=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Patient Zero |image = |-|Human = [[File:Patientzerohuman.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:Patientzerocorrupted.jpg]] |real_name = Dr. Herrschaft{{InlineQuote|Wait... What if Dr. Herrschaft is [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]? I mean, it wasn't until after the zombies started taking over the cities, and if he were to get infected it wouldn't surprise me he would be first in contact.|[[Professor V]] on Wave 25 ([[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]])}} |affiliation = Oasis X EnterpriseName mentioned in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vk7eFSlSzNA Patient Zero trailer] and on the thumbnail for [[v1.20.0]]. |position = Head Scientist (Formerly) |alliases = Dr. Herrschaft |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]], previously known as Dr. Herrschaft, was a former human scientist working for Oasis X Enterprise laboratories. [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]'s personal ideology is what led him to host the '''God Cube's''' power. He believed that mankind has been a blight on the face of the earth, and wishes to see nature thrive without the presence of humanshttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vk7eFSlSzNA. Through the creation of [[Serum Zero]]Named in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yWi2vvQ0i5U Hacker trailer]., the zombification formula synthesized from his time working at Oasis X Enterprise, [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] was able to create prototype zombies. However, these zombies did not live up to desired results. At some point, [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] acquired a '''God Cube''' fragment, using it in [[Serum Zero]] to reach the desired results. [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] tested the newly enhanced compounds on himself. The effects of the original formula were spread via the '''God Cube's''' corruption, transforming [[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] into a host, just like the many other zombies who were also infected from [[Serum Zero]].{{Clear}} ===Fallen King=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Fallen King |image = |-|Fallen = [[File:Fallenkingtrailer.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:Awakenedfallenkingrenderwhogaf.jpg]] |affiliation = The [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]] |position = King }} The [[Fallen King]] is the leader of [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]]. He and his people originate from Paradise.{{InlineQuote|The Fallen were once ordinary citizens who lived within Paradise's borders.|[[Fallen]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} His ultimate goal is the orchestration of his apocalypse,{{InlineQuote|Those who once commenced sacred rituals and called upon lost magic now raise armies of [[Necrotic Skeleton]]s to fight in the [[Fallen King]]'s apocalypse.|[[Fallen Summoner]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} which entails the total destruction of entire realms and their inhabitants.{{InlineQuote|Boldly one of the greatest threats to TDS, Fallen King has struck back with an even larger and more high-quality army. It is up to TDS to stop him from destroying more realms!|2=Video description of the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VC5ya__YI5o Fallen King Trailer]}}{{InlineQuote|Now, he rules an empty kingdom with an insatiable army that only hungers for battle. They raid endlessly, fighting because war is the only outlet they have left.|[[Fallen King]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} In the modern day, a [[Fallen Hazmat]] arrived to the kingdom, bearing a newly acquired '''God Cube''' fragment.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VC5ya__YI5o The [[Fallen King]] is presumed to empower himself with it; however, no visible mutations make themselves known in his gameplay debut. It is only after [[Hidden Wave]] is activated that the [[Fallen King]] has visible mutations on his body and likely becomes a host, as a [[???|mysterious entity]] [[Awakened Fallen King|awakens]] the king after he was seemingly defeated. It is unknown why the [[Fallen King]] chose not to, or could not, use the '''God Cube''' fragment after its acquisition. {{Clear}} ===The Umbra=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = The Umbra |image = |-|Human = [[File:Theumbraadarktale.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:Theumbrasolareclipsetrailer.jpg]] |affiliation = Eclipsed Village (Formerly)
The Dark Sun |position = Villager (Formerly)
Mistress |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/959606619/profile BethyVA] }} [[The Umbra]] was a former human who lived in a town called Eclipsed Village in the near pastBackstory revealed in [[A Dark Tale]], though the name of the village was not revealed up until [[Failed Gateway]], where the map is described as the ground zero for the [[God Cube]].. Her life was not a peaceful one, as she was wanted for witchcraft, subsequently being hunted down by the [[Executioner (Lunar Overture)|Executioner]] and the village [[Knight (Lunar Overture)|knights]]. Unlike other hosts, who absorbed only a portion of the '''God Cube's''' power through its smaller fragments, [[The Umbra]] received the '''God Cube's''' power when it was still whole. This was when the '''God Cube''' inexplicably manifested in the woods outside Eclipsed Village, luring [[The Umbra]] to it. Though, it was during her reception of its power that the '''God Cube''' was mysteriously shattered into its fragments. Later in her life, [[The Umbra]] begins searching for the shattered '''God Cube''' fragments. She uses her forces of the Dark Sun to retrieve '''God Cube''' fragments in the overworld for her, such as when the [[Jack O' Bot]] attacked [[Nightmare Carnival]], or when [[Lord Sinister]] attacked [[Trick or Threat Town]]. Her hunger for the fragments led her to take more drastic measures of procuring them. In the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], [[The Umbra]] attempted to engulf the entire population of the [[Overworld]] into the forces of Dark Sun,{{InlineQuote|In due time, this world will be engulfed within the Dark Sun! Mmm.. I can already feel the power flowing through my veins.. And soon enough, you will join me!|[[The Umbra (Narrator)|The Umbra]] on Wave 1 ([[Totality Tower]])}} supposedly to use humanity as slaves in search of '''God Cube''' shards across other realms.https://x.com/paradoxum_games/status/1479568492638748678 {{Clear}} ===Penumbras=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Penumbras |image = |-|Human = [[File:Penumbrasadarktale.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:Penumbrassolareclipsetrailer.jpg]] |affiliation = Eclipsed Village (Formerly)
The Dark Sun |position = Sorcerer (Formerly)
Head Knight }} [[Penumbras]], like [[The Umbra]], was a former human that lived in Eclipsed Village in the near past; he and [[The Umbra]] were close friends. [[Penumbras]] was a sorcerer, being able to manifest ghostly blue flames from his hands. It is presumed that later in his life, when he and [[The Umbra]] escaped Eclipsed Village and became part of the Dark Sun, [[Penumbras]] supposedly partook in the '''God Cube's''' power like [[The Umbra]],This is directly confirmed in cut dialogue for [[A Dark Tale]], though as it has been cut its canonicity is questionable.
{{InlineQuote|To officially pledge his loyalty to her cause, the novice was allured himself to become transformed alongside... [[The Umbra]].|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] in cut [[A Dark Tale]] dialogue}} being completely transformed by it. {{Clear}} ===Titus=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Titus |image = |-|Human = [[File:Titusfailedgateway.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:Tituscorrupted.png]] |aliases = Titus Maximus |affiliation=The [[Children of Exo]] |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} [[Titus]], or [[Titus]] Maximus, is one of the members the '''Children of Exo''', and was the first cultist that the [[T.D.S. Organization]] fought against. He first appears during the [[Hexscape Event]], where he and the other [[Children of Exo]] attempt to open a portal to the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] using an "''Artificial God Cube''" as the power source for the portal. However, the plan fails and they get sucked into the [[Hex Realm]]. When the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] was set free after the defeat of the [[Conserver]], it unleashed an overwhelming volume of corrupted energy from the [[God Cube]] fragment it held on to. [[Titus]] was affected by the corrupted energy, being turned into a host.{{Clear}} ===Conserver=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Conserver |image = |-|Default = [[File:Conserverthenightmarerealm.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:PlaceC.png]] |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} The [[Conserver]] is one of the many beings that reside within the [[Hex Realm]]. Given its title, the [[Conserver]] dedicated its existence to keeping either the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]], or the '''God Cube''' fragment it hosted, contained within the [[Hex Realm]]. Upon the [[Conserver]]'s defeat, the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] was unleashed, causing the [[Conserver]] to become corrupted by the energy given off by the '''God Cube''' fragment it hosted. {{Clear}} ===Primordial Drakobloxxer=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Primordial Drakobloxxer |image = Primordialdrakobloxxercontainment.jpg |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} The [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] is a being that resided within the [[Hex Realm]], being imprisoned there by the [[Conserver]]. While the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] only seems to be holding onto the fragment, thereby designating it as a '''God Cube''' fragment owner instead of a host, the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] is considered to be a host because of how the [[Dispatcher]] describes it as infected by the fragments, similar to how corruption works.{{InlineQuote|We got a match. This.. sound was logged from the Overture incident. It's believed to be a powerful entity infected by the fragments.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 17 ([[Containment]])}} When the [[Conserver]] was defeated, the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] was released from whatever bonds it might have been held within, and in the process, it unleashed a metric ton of corrupted energy from the fragment it held. It is unknown how the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] came in possession of a '''God Cube''' fragment, and why it chose not to entirely consume it. In gameplay, the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]]'s second phase caused it to adopt a purple color scheme, suggesting that it is becoming corrupted by the fragment. However, this second phase does not appear within cinematic material. {{Clear}} ===Haz3mn=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Haz3mn |image = |-|Default = [[File:Haz3mnplsdonate.jpg]] |-|Corrupted = [[File:CorruptedHazam.png]] }} Haz3mn is presumed to be the leader or governing force of the [[Pls Donate]] realm. One day, as Haz3mn was walking through his realm, he stumbled upon a '''God Cube''' fragment. Curious about the mysterious artifact, Haz3mn touched it, transforming him into [[Corrupted Haz3mn]].{{Clear}} ===Frost Spirit=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Frost Spirit |image = Frostspiritoutpost32.jpg }} The [[Frost Spirit]], according to its [[Index]] entry, is one of the most powerful entities to exist in the [[Frost Realm]]. During the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], the [[Children of Exo]] ventured into the [[Frost Realm]], entering the [[Frost Spirit]]'s castle to awaken him from his chamber using a staff powered with a [[God Cube]] fragment. Having been awakened, the [[Frost Spirit]] came out with visible neon purple veins or scars on its purple body, suggesting that either the [[Children of Exo]] corrupted him with their fragment, or it ran into a fragment in the past.{{Clear}} ==Owners== Certain characters and groups have acquired '''God Cube''' fragments, however, rather than getting corrupted by it, they took it with themselves and used it for various purposes. Most commonly, it is used either as a power source to fuel powerful machines, such as giant mechs or portals, or as a way to mind control other factions. In rare cases, certain individuals after being corrupted by the '''God Cube''' took the fragment with themselves and continued using to make themselves even stronger. An example of this would be [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]]. Such cases are not included here, as this section only includes characters or groups who have not shown any signs of corruption but are (or were) in possession of a '''God Cube''' fragment. ===Krampus=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Krampus |image = Krampustrailer.jpg }} [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] is a malevolent entity that has, on numerous occasion, terrorized the North Pole, and is a formidable opponent to [[Santa|Santa Claus]]. After his initial defeat in the [[Christmas 2019 Event]], [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] managed to acquire a fragment of the '''God Cube'''. However, he was not fully corrupted into a host, as he did not consume the fragment. Rather, [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] used the fragment in his staff to power his abilities.{{Clear}} ===Children of Exo=== {{StoryGroupInfobox |title = [[Children of Exo]] |image = ChildrenofExoStaff.jpg |items = Staff
Artificial God Cube (Formerly[[File:Outpost32Trivia1.png|280px]]
Taken by the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and left in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]].) |category = hide }} During the [[Hexscape Event]], the [[Children of Exo]] created an "''Artificial God Cube''", similar enough to the real '''God Cube''' that could be used as a power source to open portals to other realms. The intent for it was to open a portal to the [[Nil Zone]] to establish a connection to [[Lord Exo]]. The '''Children of Exo''' later come into possession of a real '''God Cube''' fragment after the [[T.D.S. Organization]] defeats the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]], taking it from the defeated beast. After acquiring this '''God Cube''' fragment, the [[Children of Exo]] begin [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E]], where they open a portal in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] to the [[Frost Realm]] to awaken the [[Frost Spirit]]. After the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], the [[Children of Exo]] continued to collect more '''God Cube''' fragments, eventually collecting roughly half of them. This eventually leads to them fighting the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], who has recently taken the other half of the fragments from the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. Both sides would fight for their fragments, but the [[Children of Exo]] would emerge victorious after getting help from the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], allowing them to merge the two halves of the [[God Cube]]. Now with the full [[God Cube]], they use it to absorb its power into the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], so that his corrupted body can be used by the reborn [[Lord Exo]]. {{Clear}} ===Nerd Duck=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] |image = NerdDuckNullVoid.png }} The [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], as he is referred to, is the son of [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]]>{{InlineQuote|[[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]]'s son is out for revenge and sending an army of ducks to steal your crops!|[[v1.2.0]] in-game update log}}, and is the de facto leader of the ducks. In the [[Ducky Revenge Event]], the ducks were beginning to starve in the [[Duck Realm]], as the portal inside the giant toilet was shut off, no longer bringing them food. The [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], checking in on the portal once more, stumbled upon a [[God Cube]] fragment laying near it. He decided that it could be used for their benefit, and had [[Ducky D00M III|another version of the Ducky D00M robot]] constructed, along with a [[Nerd Ducky|bunny mech suit]] which was powered by the [[God Cube]] fragment in hopes to fight T.D.S. once more. But he was soon defeated by them, and later recruited to work with them by [[Professor V]]. Now working with the [[T.D.S. Organization]], the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] began working with the [[Professor V]] on merging all of the '''God Cube''' fragments into one partial unified '''God Cube'''. During the merger, the fragments become unstable and start opening rifts to the [[Nil Zone]]. {{Clear}} ==Artificial God Cube== {{ItemInfobox |title = Artificial God Cube |image = ArtificialGodCube.jpg |purpose = Power Source |created_by = The [[Children of Exo]] |owners = The [[Children of Exo]] (Formerly)
The [[Conserver]] (Formerly)
The [[T.D.S. Organization]] }} The Artificial God Cube is a device that was supposedly created by the [[Children of Exo]], its power output is equivalent to one or multiple '''God Cube''' shards. It was first used by the [[Children of Exo]] to power a portal to the [[Nil Zone]], as they did possess any real '''God Cube''' fragments at the time. When the portal finished activation, it sucked the surrounding environment into it, including the Artificial God Cube. The portal did not lead to the [[Old World|Nil Zone]], but instead the [[Hex Realm]]. In the [[Hex Realm]], the [[Conserver]] found the Artificial God Cube and kept it on his person until it was taken away from him by the [[T.D.S. Organization]] after he was defeated. In the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], the Artificial God Cube was used by the [[T.D.S. Organization]] to power the portal at [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], where it remains in their possession to this day. {{Clear}} ==Story== The storyline regarding the '''God Cube''' is very fragmented. Events listed before or after another do not give them a definitive place on the time line, and most ordering of events is arbitrary. ===Old World=== Thousands of [[Two X]]'s strongest souls give up their souls as a sacrifice to create the '''God Cube'''. [[Two X]] then uses the '''God Cube''' to seal [[Lord Exo]]'s soul inside. ===A Dark Tale=== In the near past, the '''God Cube''' appeared in the forest outside Eclipsed Village through unknown means. [[The Umbra]] takes on the power of the '''God Cube''', becoming a host. The '''God Cube''' is destroyed in the process, shattering into various fragments across space and time. At some point in [[Penumbras]]' life after [[A Dark Tale]], he consumes a '''God Cube''' fragment and becomes a host. ===Survival Bosses=== At certain points, each one of the survival mode bosses comes into possession of a [[God Cube]] fragments. *[[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]] manages to acquire a '''God Cube''' fragment to use in his zombification formula. He tests the formula on himself, and is turned into a host. *A servant of the [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen Kingdom]] finds a '''God Cube''' fragment and returns it to the [[Fallen King]]. It is unknown what purpose the [[Fallen King]] used the fragment for prior to his [[Awakened Fallen King|awakening]] during the activation of the [[Hidden Wave]]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VC5ya__YI5o. *The [[Brute]], [[Grave Digger]] and [[Molten Warlord]] each at some point come across a fragment which is later taken from them by the [[T.D.S. Organization]].Shown in the first cutscene of [[Outpost 16]]. ===Krampus' Revenge=== At some point in time between his initial defeat and reappearance, [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] discovers a '''God Cube''' fragment. The fragment was then used to mind control [[Santa|Santa Claus]]' elves into serving [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] himself. ===Hexscape=== When the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] was unleashed because of the [[Conserver]]'s defeat in the [[Hex Realm]], it released a vast amount of corrupted energy that was absorbed by [[Titus]] and the [[Conserver]], transforming them into hosts. The [[Children of Exo]] steal the '''God Cube''' fragment from the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] after it was defeated. ===Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE=== The [[T.D.S. Organization]] intervenes in the [[Pls Donate]] realm, trying to stop [[Corrupted Haz3mn]] from destroying the realm after he was corrupted into a host by a '''God Cube''' fragment. ===Operation I.C.E=== The [[Children of Exo]] used their '''God Cube''' fragment powered staff to awaken the [[Frost Spirit]], commanding it to destroy the [[T.D.S. Organization]] at [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. The [[Frost Spirit]] was defeated by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. ===Ducky Revenge=== A '''God Cube''' fragment is detected in the [[Duck Realm]] sometime after being placed there by [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]].{{InlineQuote|Once [[Ramiel]] used the card and messed up their portals, I hid a shard in their toilet!|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 9 ([[Blind Faith]])}} Agents are dispatched for retrieval into the realm, but encounter the ducks using it for their dastardly machinations. The ducks are fought against, and the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] is defeated, later being recruited to work with T.D.S. by [[Professor V]]. ===Null & Void=== ====Night 1==== [[Professor V]] and the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] work on "''Project God Merger''", which aims to unify all the fragments T.D.S. has collected into a unified source. When the project goes awry, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] enters the [[Overworld]] and takes the partial '''God Cube''' away. ====Night 3==== The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] searches for the other half of the '''God Cube''' in the [[Blind Faith|Nil Zone]], where he meets and fights the [[Children of Exo]]. The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] loses, and the [[Children of Exo]] unify the '''God Cube''', releasing [[Lord Exo]] from his ancient prison into the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]'s body. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|God Cube}} Godcubelunaroverture.jpg|The '''God Cube''' in-game. {{GalleryHeader|Fragments}} Patientzerofragment.jpg|[[Patient Zero (Story)|Patient Zero]]'s fragment.
